arabic: يَا مَنْ تُحَلُّ بِهِ عُقَدُ الْمَكَارِهِ ،
وَ يَا مَنْ يَفْثَأُ بِهِ حَدُّ الشَّدَائِدِ ،
وَ يَا مَنْ يُلْتَمَسُ مِنْهُ الْمَخْرَجُ إِلَى رَوْحِ الْفَرَجِ .
ذَلَّتْ لِقُدْرَتِكَ الصِّعَابُ ،
وَ تَسَبَّبَتْ بِلُطْفِكَ الْأَسْبَابُ ،
وَ جَرَى بِقُدرَتِكَ الْقَضَاءُ ،
وَ مَضَتْ عَلَى إِرَادَتِكَ الْأَشْيَاءُ .
فَهِيَ بِمَشِيَّتِكَ دُونَ قَوْلِكَ مُؤْتَمِرَةٌ ،
وَ بِإِرَادَتِكَ دُونَ نَهْيِكَ مُنْزَجِرَةٌ .
أَنْتَ الْمَدْعُوُّ لِلْمُهِمَّاتِ ،
وَ أَنْتَ الْمَفْزَعُ فِي الْمُلِمَّاتِ ،
لَا يَنْدَفِعُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا مَا دَفَعْتَ ،
وَ لَا يَنْكَشِفُ مِنْهَا إِلَّا مَا كَشَفْتَ
وَ قَدْ نَزَلَ بِي يَا رَبِّ
مَا قَدْ تَكَأَّدَنِي ثِقْلُهُ ،
وَ أَلَمَّ بِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ .
وَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ أَوْرَدْتَهُ عَلَيَّ وَ بِسُلْطَانِكَ وَجَّهْتَهُ إِلَيَّ .
فَلَا مُصْدِرَ لِمَا أَوْرَدْتَ ،
وَ لَا صَارِفَ لِمَا وَجَّهْتَ ،
وَ لَا فَاتِحَ لِمَا أَغْلَقْتَ ، وَ لَا مُغْلِقَ لِمَا فَتَحْتَ ،
وَ لَا مُيَسِّرَ لِمَا عَسَّرْتَ ، وَ لَا نَاصِرَ لِمَنْ خَذَلْتَ .
فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ ،
وَ افْتَحْ لِي يَا رَبِّ بَابَ الْفَرَجِ بِطَوْلِكَ ،
وَ اكْسِرْ عَنِّي سُلْطَانَ الْهَمِّ بِحَوْلِكَ ،
وَ أَنِلْنِي حُسْنَ النَّظَرِ فِيمَا شَكَوْتُ ،
وَ أَذِقْنِي حَلَاوَةَ الصُّنْعِ فِيمَا سَأَلْتُ ،
وَ هَبْ لِي مِنْ لَدُنْكَ رَحْمَةً وَ فَرَجاً هَنِيئاً ،
وَ اجْعَلْ لِي مِنْ عِنْدِكَ مَخْرَجاً وَحِيّاً .
وَ لَا تَشْغَلْنِي بِالِاهْتِمَامِ عَنْ تَعَاهُدِ فُرُوضِكَ ،
وَ اسْتِعْمَالِ سُنَّتِكَ .
فَقَدْ ضِقْتُ لِمَا نَزَلَ بِي يَا رَبِّ ذَرْعاً ،
وَ امْتَلَأْتُ بِحَمْلِ مَا حَدَثَ عَلَيَّ هَمّاً ،
وَ أَنْتَ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى كَشْفِ مَا مُنِيتُ بِهِ ،
وَ دَفْعِ مَا وَقَعْتُ فِيهِ ،
فَافْعَلْ بِي ذَلِكَ وَ إِنْ لَمْ أَسْتَوْجِبْهُ مِنْكَ ،
يَا ذَا الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
transliteration: wa yā man yaftha’u bihi ḥaddu-sh-shadā’id,
wa yā man yultamasu minhu-l-makhraju ilā rawḥi-l-faraj.
Lā yandafi‘u minhā illā mā dafa‘t,
wa lā yankashifu minhā illā mā kashaft
Wa qad nazala bī yā Rabb
wa alamma bī mā qad bahaẓanī ḥamluh.
Wa bi-qudratika awradtahu ‘alayya wa bi-sulṭānika wajjahtahu ilayy.
wa lā fātiḥa limā aghlaqt, wa lā mughliqa limā fataḥt,
wa lā muyassira limā ‘assart, wa lā nāṣira liman khadhalt.
wa-ftaḥ lī yā Rabbi bāba-l-faraji bi-ṭawlik,
wa hab lī min ladunka raḥmatan wa farajan hanī’ā,
Wa lā tashghalnī bil-ihtimāmi ‘an ta‘āhudi furūḍik,
Fa-qad ḍiqtu limā nazala bī yā Rabbi dhar‘ā,
wa anta-l-qādiru ‘alā kashfi mā munītu bih,
Fa-f‘al bī dhālika wa in lam astawjibhu mink,
translation: O He by whom the knots of detested things are untied,
O He by whom the sharpness of hardships is blunted,
O He from whom an escape to the relief of deliverance is sought!
Difficulties are humbled by Your power,
means are made to function by Your gentleness,
destiny runs its course by Your power,
and things proceed according to Your will.
So they are, by Your will, obedient without Your word,
and by Your desire, restrained without Your prohibition.
You are the One called upon for important matters,
You are the refuge in afflictions.
None of them is repelled except what You repel,
and none of them is unveiled except what You unveil.
And indeed, O Lord, there has befallen me
that whose weight has overburdened me,
and that whose burden has exhausted me has afflicted me.
By Your power You brought it upon me, and by Your authority You directed it to me.
So there is no averter for what You have brought,
nor any deflector for what You have directed,
nor any opener for what You have closed, nor any closer for what You have opened,
nor any easer for what You have made difficult, nor any helper for whom You have forsaken.
So bless Muhammad and his Household,
and open for me, O Lord, the door of relief by Your bounty,
and break from me the dominion of anxiety by Your strength,
and grant me good insight into what I have complained of,
and let me taste the sweetness of [Your] making in what I have asked for,
and grant me from Yourself a pleasant mercy and relief,
and appoint for me from Yourself a swift way out.
And do not preoccupy me with anxiety from attending to Your obligations,
and practicing Your Sunnah.
For I am, O Lord, straitened in capacity by what has befallen me,
and filled with worry by bearing what has occurred to me.
And You are able to uncover what I have been afflicted with,
and repel what I have fallen into.
So do that for me, even if I do not deserve it from You,
O Possessor of the Great Throne!
